name: agents
description: Agent orchestration: orchestrate (run a spec'd feature or task list with role-separated agents, a strong model to think, plan and review and a fast model to build, routed by task for token-efficient use; agent-agnostic with Claude as the default) and parallel (several features or tracks at once, each on its own branch in a worktree, landed on dev one at a time)

tokenStatus.title: Token status
tokenStatus.description: A status line with the cards in flight (projected / used) and what the budget leaves, a toast when the wave stops fitting or a card passes its projection, and /tokens; read from .ai-gent/orchestrate-status.md and token_report.py budget

tokenRefreshSeconds.title: Token status refresh (seconds)
tokenRefreshSeconds.description: How often, after a turn, the budget is read again (it reads a week of transcripts)

tokenBurnRate.title: Token burn rate and ETA
tokenBurnRate.description: After each cap in the token status, how long what it leaves lasts at the current account-wide pace (session left 3.10M (~2h10m)); the script computes it, the window is rate_window_minutes in .ai-gent/budget.yaml

tokenEtaWarnMinutes.title: Token ETA warning (minutes)
tokenEtaWarnMinutes.description: A toast when a cap would run out within this many minutes at the current pace, once per crossing; 0 turns the toast off and keeps the status
